### **AF Screening and Detection** 

The probability of AF detection increases with electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring duration. The benefits of screening for AF in the general population to detect asymptomatic AF are currently uncertain.<sup>4</sup> An implantable loop recorder (ILR) is a subcutaneous device that can continuously monitor heart rhythm for about 4 years.
